title: PointRend: Image Segmentation As Rendering
mechanism: A point head predicts labels at adaptively selected uncertain points from fine and coarse features with iterative subdivision.
adaptation: Point head on stride-1/2 features with top-k uncertain points per cell; acts as a hard-pixel sampler. Risk: the uncertain band is the 1-2 px label jitter.
min_experiment: Arm: house PF + point head; baseline: house PF; CV crack IoU, relF1@2, components >= 20 px found. Kill if all n.d.
evidence: R: gains on COCO and Cityscapes instance and semantic segmentation.

alt_notes.adaptation: Point head on stride-1/2 features of U-Net++, top-k uncertain points per cell; risk that the uncertain band is the 1 to 2 px label jitter, so pair it with relF1@2 scoring rather than strict IoU.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm house PF + point head vs house PF; 5-fold CV crack relF1@2, gridline IoU; kill: relF1@2 n.d. and gridline < +0.02. About 10 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Keep only the uncertain-point head: an MLP over [EL intensity, stride-1/2 features, coarse logits] at the top-k ensemble-uncertain points, extra loss on those points during training; no subdivision needed at 512 px.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: U-Net++ + point head, 5 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2, gridline IoU. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012 and relF1@2 < +0.01.
